modifier_claims.support_quote: Tumor consisted of elongated spindle cells with vesicular nucleus arrayed in a palisade pattern among large cystic cavities lined by single-layer squamous epithelium. Markedly nuclear pleomorphism present in some tumor cells.
A 35 × 9 mm sized mass occupying the spinal canal at T8-T9 level. Well-circumscribed intradural extramedullary lesion
modifier_claims.value: Intradural extramedullary, spinal canal at T8-T9 level
